notes.title: Terradune Version 1.2: The Armor Overhaul Update!
notes.notes:
Terradune Version 1.2: The Armor Overhaul Update!


Armor
Added 3 new types of armor, those being:

 Wood
 Copper
 Gold


 Stats on all of the armor types has been modified (see Balance Adjustments)
 Armor can now have affixes on them, for example:

X Armor Increases the dash duration by X seconds.

Shop

 Yosbar no longer sells Iron Armor, he now sells Copper Armor (150 gold per armor type)


Crafting

 You can now craft Wood and Iron Armor in the Craft Tab


Scrolls

 Added scrolls for Wood And Iron Armor Types (so chest, head, etc)
 Scrolls can now drop from monsters in any area
 Scrolls are now more rare to drop from monsters


Stats

Added an Attack Speed Stat


Balance Adjustments

Armor

Iron:

 Iron Sword now grants +25 Strength and +25 Attack Speed (was +15 of everything)
 Iron Chest now grants +25 Health, and +25 Armor (was +15 of everything)
 Iron Helmet now grants +25 Health and +25 Physical Resistance (was +15 of everything)
 Iron Boots now grants +25 Movement Speed, and +25 Agility (was +15 of everything)
 Iron Gloves now grants +25 Armor and +25 Strength (was +15 of everything)


Archer

 Triple Shot now has a cooldown of 5 seconds (was 3)


Wizard

 Fireball now seeks out enemies by itself
 Fireball now does 6 damage (was 12)
 Baton Strike now has a cooldown of 4 seconds (was 3)


Knight

 Heavy Slash now always deals Critical Damage
 Heavy Slash now takes 0.9 seconds to cast (was 0.5)
 Heavy Slash now stuns the target for 1 second (was 2 seconds)
 Heavy Slash now has a cooldown of 2.5 seconds (was 3)
 Heavy Slash now does 13 damage per hit (was 19) <- This is counted WITHOUT Critical hits.
 Berserk now increases your strength by 15 (was 10)
 Berserk now makes you move 1.5x your speed (was 1.2x)
 The Speed duration now lasts for 2 seconds (was 3)
 Berserk now has a cooldown of 15 seconds (was 10)
 Berserk now costs 25 mana to cast (was 20)

notes.title: Teradune Version 1.1 — The Mines Update!
notes.notes:
Teradune Version 1.1 — The Mines Update!

New Content

New Zone: The Mines!

 Added a new zone, The Mines, featuring 10+ quests.


Quality-of-Life Improvements


 Summoned units now display a blue health bar (previously red).
 Added a Respawn button in the Death Menu.
 Each quest in the journal now includes an icon for improved readability.
 Added a Quit to Desktop option in the Pause menu.
 The game now launches in Windowed Fullscreen by default. (was Windowed)


Stats

 Added a Movement Speed stat, starting with 5 points.


Balance Adjustments
Armor

 All Iron armor pieces now grant +15 to all attributes.

Systems

Benediction:

 Mana regeneration adjusted to 5 per 2 s (from 10 per 2 s).


Consumables:

 Health and Mana potions now restore 25 health/mana (from 50).


Archer

Triple Shot:

 Projectile speed increased to 20 (from 15).


Toxic Shot:

 Cooldown reduced to 3 s (from 4 s).
 Poison duration reduced to 2 s (from 4 s).
 Poison damage increased to 6 per tick (from 5).


Knight

 Quick Slash: Cooldown set to 0.5 s (previously no cooldown).


Enemies

Durability:

 All monsters’ HP has been increased by 50%.


Progression:

 In Eldham Village, monsters now scale by zone from level 1 to level 6.


This build is set to release next wednesday!

notes.title: Last Minute Balance Changes
notes.notes:
After a final round of internal testing, we’ve made a few targeted nerfs to the Summoner to bring its power more in line with other classes. These tweaks focus on reducing some of its oppressive pressure without compromising its unique identity as a battlefield controller.

Fireball

 Damage reduced to 12 (was 15)
 Now has a cooldown of 0,5 seconds (was 0)

Dev Note: Fireball was hitting a bit too hard for a basic ranged option, especially when used repeatedly at range. This change encourages more thoughtful positioning and combo play rather than raw damage spamming.

Summon Slimes

 Poison duration reduced to 4 seconds (was 6 seconds)

Dev Note: Slimes were proving a bit too sticky in extended fights. This adjustment dials back their ability to zone and chip away at opponents, while still preserving their utility in controlling space.

notes.title: Terradune Version 1.0: The Summoner Update!
notes.notes:
New Class: Summoner

 A brand new Summoner class has been added!


New Abilities (Summoner)
The Summoner starts strong with 7 unique abilities (with more on the way!):


 Summon Skeletons

 Summon Slimes

 Fireball

 Regenerate Allies (name subject to change)

 Regroup – Teleports all summoned minions to your location.

 Punch

 Necromancy


More Summoner abilities will be added in future updates!

UI Improvements


 Improved several ability icons.



 Slightly adjusted the position of the Health and Mana bars.



 Fixed minor visual issues in the ability UI.



 Added a minimap in the top-right corner of the screen.


Quality of Life

 Added an NPC in Eldham Village who lets you reset all character points in the "Character" tab—for a cost.


Balance Changes
General

 Blessing now heals allies as well as the player (previously only healed the player).


Knight

Heavy Slash



 Stun duration reduced to 1 second (was 2).



 Cooldown reduced to 2 seconds (was 3).



 Berserk



 Cooldown reduced to 10 seconds (was 30).



 Strength buff duration reduced to 3 seconds (was 5).



 Acceleration duration reduced to 5 seconds (was 10).



 Mana cost increased to 20 (was 10).


Wizard
Baton Strike


 Damage increased to 10 (was 6).



 Stun duration increased to 2 seconds (was 1.5).



 Cooldown increased to 3 seconds (was 2).


Archer
Slow Shot


 Slow duration reduced to 3 seconds (was 5).



 Damage increased to 10 (was 6).



 Movement speed reduction adjusted to 0.3x (was 0.5x).



Sticky Shot



 Damage increased to 10 (was 6).


Enemies

 All enemies have received a minor buff to make gameplay slightly more challenging—without being overwhelming!


Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue where the walking animation would break after respawning.



 Fixed monster spawners not working correctly—monsters will now respawn as intended.



 Fixed a bug preventing players from deleting save files.

notes.title: Terradune Version 0.8: The Village Overhaul Update!
notes.notes:
Zones

Eldhalm Village:
 The village area (first zone) is now way bigger, and has way more stuff to Explore,
 added 2 new zones in the village,
 Added 10 more quests to play through in the village,
 Reworked monsters in the village area to have new attacks, etc,
 The harbor and mountain has been removed,
 added new npcs in one of the new zones,
 some dialogue has been reworked,
 improved the interior of every house in the village,

Ai Improvements (pushed in the last update)
 Monsters now have a minimum chase timer, i.e., if you are at the edge of the range of a monster, and attack it and run away, it won't just stop chasing you, it will chase you outside it's range for at least the duration of the min chase timer. Secondly, enemies now alert other enemies around the provoked enemy,

Skill tree
 A skill tree has been added to the game for every type of class/crafting (magic, archery, blacksmithing etc)

Experience Bar
 An experience bar has been added to the game,

Item Conditions
 Item Conditions has been added to the game for example you need to be level 20 to equip a certain item etc,

Balance Changes
General:
 Dash now increases your speed for 2 seconds (was 1),
 Necromancy now has a cooldown of 20 (was 60),

Knight:
 Heavy Slash now stuns the target for 2 seconds (was 0.5),
 Heavy Slash now has a cooldown of 3 (was 2),
 Berserk now has a cooldown of 30 (was 60),

Wizard:
 Firecone now has a cooldown of 2 (was 3),
 Firecone now does 3 damage per fireball (was 4),
 Fireball now has a cooldown of 0,5 seconds (was 1),

Archer:
 Triple Arrow now does 3 damage per arrow (was 1),
 Triple Arrow now has a cooldown of 4 (was 3),

Bug Fixes
 Fixed a rare issue where cooldowns wouldn't work,
 Fixed an issue where the necromancer would sometimes not spawn,
 Fixed an issue where you'd spawn in the village sometimes when starting the game,
 Fixed an issue where the Heavy Slash ability sometimes wouldn't apply the stun effect,

This build is set to release in about a week

notes.title: Terradune Version 0.7 Patch Notes: The Desert Update!
notes.notes:
Features
Core Systems:
Reworked movement system
Reworked the dialogue system to be asynchronous.
Reworked the NPC icon system into a more versatile "Floating Icon" system
Checkpoint system has been added for player respawning and defining initial player position

Character and Animations:
Added support for multiple character animation strategies, including polydirectional (4-directional & 8-directional).

Abilities:
Added dozens of new abilities including summoning, status effect arrows, and self-boosting abilities.
Added cooldown system for abilities.
Added a system for abilities to apply customizable immediate effects (damage, heal, etc.) and temporal effects (status).
Added a passive ability to restore mana over time.
Added a cooldown per target to the corrosion ability, enabling the disabling of invincibility frames for more challenging gameplay.
Dash has been added back as an Ability, and now accelerates the player for 1 second
Added new icons for various abilities.
Updated the ability menu to display active and passive abilities with improved UX when equipping abilities.


Item and Equipments:
Added support for negative stats on equipment.
Added extra validation to prevent characters from equipping or unequipping items that would be fatal.
Added 2 new items: reviving orb (enables respawning on death) and ability unlock scrolls.

Control and Interface:
Mouse support for targeting and UI navigation has been added.
Message display above the ability bar when casting fails, explaining the reason has been added (insufficient mana, ability in cooldown, etc.).
Improved the pushback direction based on hit location.

Maps And Quests:
Added three new maps: Brusselia Forest, Plains and a Desert!
Added a new quests in the Brusselia Forest and Desert with in-game cinematics (camera and character movements).
Added a new NPC (Joe) and monsters (Fungus, Dinosaurs, Orcs and Bandits).
Added new music to zones and the main menu.


Balance Changes

General:
Punch now does 1 damage (was 2)

Knight:
Quick Slash now does 2 damage per slash (was 5)
Quick Slash now has a Cooldown of 1 second
Heavy Slash now has a cooldown of 2 seconds
Heavy Slash now does 4 damage per hit (was 3)
Heavy Slash now stuns the target for 1 second

Archer:
Quck Shot now does 2 damage (was 5)
Quick Shot now has a cooldown of 1
Triple Shot now does 1 damage per arrow (was 2)

Wizard:
Fireball now does 2 damage (was 4)
Fireball now has a cooldown of 1 second
Firecone now does 4 damage per fireball (was 3)
Firecone now has a cooldown of 5 seconds
Baton Stroke now stuns the target for 0,5 seconds
Baton Stroke now does 1 damage (was 3)
Baton Stroke now has a cooldown of 1 second


New Abilities

Knight:
Berserk
Dash
Necromancy
Benediction (passive)

Archer:
Toxic Shot
Slow Shot
Sticky Shot
Benediction (passive)
Dash
Necromancy

Wizard:
Necromancy
Meditation
Dash
Benediction (passive)

Bug Fixes:
Fixed issue where dashing into obstacles sometimes caused characters to get stuck.
Fixed projectiles occasionally passing through walls.
Fixed incorrect character stat updates after equipping/unequipping items multiple times.
Fixed incorrect character stat updates after equipping/unequipping items multiple times.
Fixed errors occurring when a character died during dialogue.
Fixed issue where characters could end up inside walls upon death.
Fixed health bar offset problems after multiple deaths when resource bar shaking was enabled.
Fixed incorrectly set tile rules that caused visual artifacts in paths and water.
Fixed issue where enemies couldn't see through water.

notes.title: Alpha Version 0.6 Final Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Alpha Version 0.6 Final Patch Notes
Dungeons:
Dungeons have been added to the game

What are dungeons? Dungeons are based on a difficulty, there will be a total of three difficultes: easy, medium, hard, the harder each one gets, the bigger the layout will, however also the harder it gets, the better rewards you get, and yes those are farmable, you just have to run them again each time, however on release there will only be one easy dungeon, this is to see that everthing works as it should, etc.

AI Followers:
AI Followers have been added to the game

Quests:
More quests has been added to play through, including a quest to play through a dungeon

Balance Changes:

General:
Starting Health and Mana has been increased to 10 (was 5)
Punch now deals 1 damage (was 3)
Developer Note: After the recent balance changes to Punch (which made it do 3 damage), it became way more overpowered than what i expected, this is why i'm also reverting this buff, to make it not be as good as it is now.

Archer:
Triple Arrow now deals 2 damage per Arrow (was 3)

Necromancer:
Health increased by 10%
Developer Note: As of now, the Necromancer is way easier to kill than intended, and this being a level 3 quest, it should not be this easy, however the damage increase change was removed due to it already doing lots of damage, and increasing it even more would make it way too hard, considering it's the first quest you do in the game.

Bug Fixes:
Fixed an issue where you could die during a dialogue
Fixed an issue that makes a single click in dialogue, skip the animation of the next dialogue

This build is set to release in 2-3 days
